g.text: Llama-3.1-8B, s = 4096, b = 1: sbh = 16.8M → 34·sbh ≈ 0.57 GB per layer, × 32 layers ≈ 18.3 GB (no recomputation)

g.text: s × s tensors: FlashAttention does not store them (recomputes in the backward pass)

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #86868b

g.text: After Korthikanti et al. 2022, §4.1 (GPT layer, 16-bit activations, 1-byte dropout masks)
